translation_orbit_theorem.Smith_role: the Smith decomposition names the finite translation group; no cyclic assumption is used
translation_orbit_theorem.compression: exact factor N on both sides
translation_orbit_theorem.statement: For any finite HNF quotient Q, simultaneous translation acts freely on every ordered face token because a stabilizer fixes its first marked site and hence is the identity. Source and cover orbits therefore all have size |Q|. Normalize a token by translating its first marked site to zero. A matching of the normalized orbit graph lifts uniformly to a fractional matching of the full graph; integrality of the bipartite matching polytope then gives a collision-free full matching. Conversely any full matching averages to an orbit flow, so orbit and full Hall saturation are equivalent.
